title: Hatsune Miku — Watching Over Those First Feelings〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Someday, From the Depths of Despair

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<I guess that's it for today.
Why don't we head back to SEKAI?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, Miku and Luka are back...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You two going to see the others is pretty rare.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: To be fair, Luka made me go.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you're glad you went, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes. It was nice hearing their stories.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: About the things that happened before we were here, or this SEKAI for that matter.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Why don't you tell them more, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: So that's how Kanade and Mafuyu first met...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Initially, this SEKAI had nothing in it.
No people either.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Which means her song had that much of an effect on Mafuyu.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As a result, she began making her own music out of wanting to know exactly why.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But to be fair, she started out by making a different arrangement of one of Kanade's old songs.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Nonetheless, she was in so much pain and had no idea what to do, but she felt compelled to do anything she could about it...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Both Kanade and Mafuyu were apparently dealing with quite a bit back then...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. They're still carrying some of that pain, but that's not the whole story.

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I'm not sure how to describe it...

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: But I liked it, I think...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Anyway, you finished writing those lyrics?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: I think I found the words I was looking for...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
The words you were looking for...?
You never say stuff like that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: This is totally different from what you usually write...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Between your usual exclamations, there's thoughtfulness. Like you're trying to console someone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Although they each carry a different kind of pain, the others are there for her now.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: See? Isn't it nice to actually do something for a change instead of just waiting around?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hey, I didn't specifically say that a certain someone should change their ways.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Here we go again...
Don't you two ever get sick of doing this?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka, you did startle me quite a bit by taking me over there the way you did, but I'm glad I went.
